hints.en: `shuffled = list(items)` builds a new list; `shuffle` mixes that one, not the original.

hints.tr: `rng = random.Random(seed)` ve `rng.shuffle(shuffled)`. Sonra dilimle: `shuffled[:n_test]` test, `shuffled[n_test:]` eğitim.
hints.en: `rng = random.Random(seed)` and `rng.shuffle(shuffled)`. Then slice: `shuffled[:n_test]` is the test set, `shuffled[n_test:]` the training set.

hints.tr:
Çözümün tamamı:

```python
import random


def split(items, test_share, seed):
    shuffled = list(items)
    random.Random(seed).shuffle(shuffled)
    n_test = round(len(shuffled) * test_share)
    return shuffled[n_test:], shuffled[:n_test]


customers = ["C1", "C2", "C3", "C4", "C5", "C6", "C7", "C8", "C9", "C10"]
train, test = split(customers, 0.3, 1)
print("test:", test)
print("again:", split(customers, 0.3, 1)[1])
print("other seed:", split(customers, 0.3, 2)[1])
print("original:", customers[:3])
```

The full solution:

```python
import random


def split(items, test_share, seed):
    shuffled = list(items)
    random.Random(seed).shuffle(shuffled)
    n_test = round(len(shuffled) * test_share)
    return shuffled[n_test:], shuffled[:n_test]


customers = ["C1", "C2", "C3", "C4", "C5", "C6", "C7", "C8", "C9", "C10"]
train, test = split(customers, 0.3, 1)
print("test:", test)
print("again:", split(customers, 0.3, 1)[1])
print("other seed:", split(customers, 0.3, 2)[1])
print("original:", customers[:3])
```

hint.tr: Ortak üretecin tohumuna dokunma; `random.Random(seed)` ile kendi üretecini kur.
hint.en: Don't touch the shared generator's seed; build your own with `random.Random(seed)`.
